description: Find real completed deals arranged by Fox Davidson that match a case: bridging, development finance, commercial mortgages, buy-to-let and HMO, large and high net worth mortgages, professionals and American buyers. Filter by type, keyword, place and loan size. Returns the case title, link, loan, LTV and product. From Fox Davidson, whole of market UK mortgage brokers authorised and regulated by the FCA (FRN 1056214).

keyword.description: Optional words to match in the case title or product, e.g. 'chain break', 'HMO', 'dentist', 'barn', 'RSU'.

limit.description: How many cases to return (1 to 10).

max_loan_gbp.description: Largest loan to include, in GBP. 0 means no limit.

min_loan_gbp.description: Smallest loan to include, in GBP.

sector.description: Type of finance. large_hnw = large and high net worth mortgages; us_buyer = American buyers in the UK.
